description: Cardinal Health, Inc., an Ohio corporation formed in 1979, is a global healthcare services and products company providing customized solutions for hospitals, healthcare systems, pharmacies, ambulatory surgery centers, clinical laboratories, physician offices and patients in the home. It provides pharmaceuticals and medical products and cost-effective services and solutions that enhance the healthcare system and supply chain efficiency, and connects patients, providers, payers, pharmacists and manufacturers for integrated care coordination. It reports its financial results in two reportable segments, Pharmaceutical and Specialty Solutions and Global Medical Products and Distribution, with all remaining operating segments included in Other, which is comprised of Nuclear and Precision Health Solutions, at-Home Solutions and OptiFreight Logistics.
